fixture.description: Original synthetic dialogue; deliberately includes context, slang, sarcasm, numbers and split sentences. Not a representative corpus of all films.

cues.text:
- Are you coming to dinner?
- I’ll be there in ten minutes.
Don’t wait for me. Go ahead and eat.
I haven’t eaten since noon.
There’s some soup in the fridge.
Heat it for ninety seconds, not nine minutes.
[doorbell rings]
You told Maya the party was a surprise, right?
No. Leo spilled the beans before I could stop him.
Great. So much for keeping it under wraps.
Don’t throw him under the bus. I let it slip first.
Then we’re both in hot water.
Let’s call it a day and sort this out tomorrow.
[Rain pours through a hole in the roof.]
Oh, perfect. An indoor swimming pool.

- Should I call a plumber?
- No, invite the neighbors over for a swim.
I’m kidding. Get a bucket.
And don’t tell the landlord we’re having a pool party.
He’d probably charge us extra.
Maya handed Leo the keys because he was driving.
She stayed behind to lock the office.
The bank called about the loan.
We’ll meet by the river bank after lunch.
Can you give me a hand with this box?
Sure. Just don’t drop it on my foot again.
I didn’t say
you stole the money.
I said the money was missing.
You can’t rule her out
just because she’s your sister.
I never said she was innocent.
That meeting was a train wreck.
The client ghosted us right after.

- So the deal is dead?
- Not yet. We still have a shot.
I’m down, as long as we don’t cut corners.
Keep me posted. And break a leg tomorrow.
If they offer less than fifteen thousand, walk away.

method.scope: Provider-engine timing, not an end-to-end streaming-player benchmark. Browser: production adapter in isolated document world of installed Chrome. Google: production direct HTTP adapter in Node. Codex: official app-server adapter in Node, one resident process. No extension cache. Companion polling, player capture and rendering are excluded.
method.sample: 36 original synthetic English subtitle cues, deliberately rich in idioms and context; target Simplified Chinese. Three repeats, four windows per repeat (10/10/10/6 cues). Provider order rotates between repeats. LLM receives up to 24 nearby context-only cues. Accepted translations from earlier windows are included in nearby context, matching the final extension. Fixture category annotations are never sent to providers.
method.review: Qualitative review by the coding assistant, not a blinded study or independent human evaluation. No population-level accuracy percentage is claimed. Prompts were not tuned to these sentences. An exploratory review revealed name drift; accepted-translation context was added and this final version was rerun. This is not an independent held-out evaluation.
method.browserPreparation: Measured in a fresh temporary browser profile with automated polling. Download time depends on existing components, network and browser policies. Playwright component-download suppression was disabled.

review.codex_name_consistency: Maya and Leo remained consistent across all three final runs after accepted translations were supplied as context. Not a guarantee for other episodes.
review.google: No clear meaning error found in the selected idiom, negation and number checks; names can still vary (Leo vs transliteration). This is not proof of perfect translation.
